decisions.reason: Because the firm publicly created a dedicated business unit for offshore markets, management is likely to justify staying the course and treat any weak uptake as temporary.
As a close extension of maritime support services, and with 2020-2021 travel disruption offering an external explanation for weak results, management would be inclined to continue.
The portal fits a broader digital-service direction, but its lower apparent sunk cost and less visible commitment make it somewhat easier to discontinue if adoption lagged.
The mobile app appears to be the most easily reversible and least publicly committed add-on, so management is more likely to shift resources away from it despite some prior investment.
